Test Case 7: Git Push Operation Validation

Input:
- Pod: devbob-0, devbob-1, devbob-2
- Working Directory: /tmp/test-repo-TIMESTAMP (from commit test)
- Commands:
  1. git checkout -b validation-test-TIMESTAMP
  2. git push origin validation-test-TIMESTAMP -f

Expected Output:
- Enumerating objects: N, done.
- Counting objects: 100% (N/N), done.
- Writing objects: 100% (N/N), done.
- To https://github.com/metabob-labs/test-repo.git
- * [new branch] validation-test-TIMESTAMP -> validation-test-TIMESTAMP

Expected Output (on failure):
- fatal: Authentication failed
- Permission denied (publickey)
- fatal: Could not read from remote repository

Validation:
- Output must NOT contain 'fatal', 'Authentication failed', 'Permission denied'
- Must show successful push to remote
- Tests git credentials and push capability
